stories.h: Longview mill owner hit with record $10M state penalties
stories.s: State regulators fined Nippon Dynawave over $10.1 million, including L&I's largest-ever safety fine, saying it kept a thinning tank in service before the May implosion that killed 11. L&I will seek a criminal referral; the company plans to appeal.

stories.h: Girls' winter athletes must prove biological sex by Dec. 3
stories.s: Under voter-approved I-638, WIAA requires grade 7–12 girls winter athletes to file a medically signed sex attestation by Dec. 3 to compete. A lawsuit seeks to block the law; a hearing is set for the same day.

stories.h: Strong El Niño points to mild winter, thin snowpack
stories.s: Forecasters say a strengthening El Niño, possibly among the strongest since 1950, favors a warmer Western Washington winter. That could mean a fourth straight below-normal snowpack and strain on summer water supplies.

stories.h: Weekend WSDOT closures hit I-90, I-5, SR 527, SR 18
stories.s: Overnight lane closures are set on I-90 in Bellevue, I-5 near the Nisqually River Bridge, and SR 527 near I-405. Eastbound SR 18 between Issaquah-Hobart Road and I-90 fully closes Sunday 9–11 p.m.

talking.s: Tyler Robles' 46-yard field goal in overtime gave UW (7-4) a home-finale upset of 9-1 Indiana at Husky Stadium. Demond Williams Jr. threw for 227 yards and ran for 88.

talking.h: Forest Service releases 1982 WA Bigfoot hoax files
talking.s: Newly released records detail a 1982 probe of supposed Sasquatch tracks in the Mill Creek watershed. A Border Patrol tracker and a Forest Service biologist concluded the prints were likely faked.

talking.h: Seattle bar's ladies-night email sparks backlash, threats
talking.s: Art Marble 21's owner says he's received death threats and a wave of one-star reviews after a staff email barring men in women's clothing from ladies-night deals spread online. Trans advocates call it discrimination.

coming.h: Eastbound SR 18 full closure near Issaquah
coming.s: All eastbound lanes close 9–11 p.m. between Issaquah-Hobart Road SE and I-90; freight should detour via I-5 and I-405.

coming.h: Alaska Airlines workers picket at SEA, HQ
coming.s: IAM-represented agents and ramp workers hold informational pickets Monday over wages, job security and AI protections; union and airline say no flight disruptions expected.
WSF expects long vehicle lines Nov. 25–29; king tides will cancel some Port Townsend/Coupeville sailings and holiday schedules run on Thanksgiving Day.

coming.h: Huskies close regular season at Oregon
coming.s: UW travels to Eugene for its regular-season finale against the rival Ducks the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
